architecture.decision: Pure HTML extraction module receiving caller-fetched HTML; persistence deferred because no neutral store-page observation table exists.

provenance: Per-field method and source path retained for extracted values. Conflicting values are preserved in unresolved with provenance; product records and offers are not merged across variants.
limitations: No fetcher; redirect, DNS/IP safety, timeout, and response-size enforcement belong to future fetch integration.
Syntactic HTTP(S) URL validation does not resolve or reject private destination IPs.
Generic microdata/RDFa and broad fallback selectors are not implemented.
No live network test or crawl was performed.

coverage: no trusted price evidence workflow reference

recommendation: A future integration worker can add a constrained public-page fetch adapter and, if append-only extraction history is required, propose a dedicated store-page observation table for review before any migration.
